name: Campbell's - Goodyear AZ
type: Manufacturing - snacks/food production (Snyder's of Hanover pretzel plant)

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '13301 W Van Buren St' and roster coords (33.44986,-112.34641) geocoded to a residential block and were wrong. Correct facility is the Campbell Snacks / Snyder's of Hanover pretzel plant at 1200 N Bullard Ave, Goodyear AZ 85338 - confirmed via web search, OSM ('Campbell's Food' node) and satellite, with 'Campbell's Snacks' building signage visible in Street View. Locked center 33.4595,-112.3795.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entrance is an open driveway off the I-10 south frontage road at the NE corner; no barrier arm or sliding gate visible in z19-z20 satellite. Open-access site.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance or anywhere along the access road in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two trailer-parking areas: a row of ~15-20 drop trailers on the W dock yard and a marked drop yard on the S/SE apron holding ~20+ trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors along the W building face (~12-15 trailers backed in visible) plus a SW/S dock cluster; 25-50 band, estimate ~32, flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town: plant is bordered by I-10 to the north and active agricultural fields to the south/east/west - rural industrial setting on the western fringe of metro Phoenix.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access/loop road wraps from the NE entrance around to the W docks - ample stacking depth for 3+ trucks inside the property.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing/warehouse building plus a small utility/outbuilding on the south side.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
